programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The camera follows the fate of three drivers setting off from Kielce to the Silesian Beskids to urgently order wood.Unfortunately, the weather is deteriorating, which does not make their task any harder.One of the trucks falls into a mountain stream.New pilot Ania, together with experienced driver Tomek, sets off on a route to Hamburg with a 40-ton concrete pump.Complications arise.Meanwhile, in the family company near Opole, preparations are underway for the largest transport in the 35-year history of the plant - a trip for a 200-ton reactor.The main drivers, Mirek and Makuwa, are struggling with a hydraulic system failure.
